'''2000 Sullust Regionals''' was the Star Wars CCG regional championship for the Sullust region (Croatia, Czech Republic, Greece, Hungary, Poland, Slovakia, Slovenia, Turkey) in the 2000 Decipher championship circuit.<ref name="dc00fin">[http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html DecipherCon 2000: Star Wars CCG Qualifiers], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010308110320/http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="rl00sullust">[http://christo.decipher.com/regionals/swlist.html?game=sw&region=sullust 2000 Regionals: Sullust], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010728165517/http://christo.decipher.com/regionals/swlist.html?game=sw&region=sullust Internet Archive]</ref>

[[Leszek Chrobak]] of Pisarzowice, Poland won and qualified for the [[2000 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dc00fin" />

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Regional championship
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Date:''' 4 June 2000
* '''Site:''' SP 71 ul. Podwale 57 Wroclaw, Poland
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Krzysztof Pawlowski]]
